top_choice_rationale: P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) rewards a new classification of insulators, the Z2 invariant protected by time-reversal symmetry and spin-orbit coupling, together with its decisive experimental realisation in HgTe quantum wells. The edge-channel conductance has been confirmed over fifteen to twenty years by independent groups and probes, so the work is mature, and the Kane-Mele joint theory step is kept intact. The allocation is a compromise forced by the three-name limit, since Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang and Hasan's 3D ARPES work are left out, and the citation must be kept narrow to the quantum spin Hall state and Z2 class so it does not repeat the 2016 prize. P002 (optical lattice clocks) has cleaner attribution and is a sound second choice, but it is an instrument advance next to the 2005 and 2012 prizes and less of a reorganisation of a field. No award is the least preferred, since two mature, defensible candidates exist.
